title: Analog Clock
description: Interactive p5.js analog clock simulation with manual and automatic modes, demonstrating trigonometric functions for calculating clock hand positions using sine and cosine.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Analog Clock
Trigonometry
Sine and Cosine
p5.js
Polar Coordinates
learningObjectives: Calculate the (x, y) position of a clock hand's tip from a time value using cos() and sin() after mapping the value to radians
Explain why the angle mapping subtracts HALF_PI so that 12 o'clock points straight up instead of to the right
Convert seconds (0-59), minutes (0-59), and hours (0-11) into angles around the clock face using proportional mapping to TWO_PI
Compare automatic mode, which reads the system time, with manual mode, which sets the hands from the hour, minute, and second sliders
Predict where each hand will point for a slider-chosen time before switching to manual mode to verify
